subject: Post-discovery: booking 30m product preview — stakeholder time options
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + propose 3 windows for 30m product preview

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap of what we heard:
- SouthBridge is evaluating an inference platform to standardize internal apps (search, summarization, and a customer-facing agent).
- Primary constraints: sub-100ms median token latency for the agent, tenant isolation for PII, and a tight infrastructure budget for Q1 2027.
- Key stakeholders to include in the next session: Priya (Head of Data), Rahul (Security/Infra), and one engineering lead.

Next suggested step: a 30-minute product preview focused on how Redwood handles latency SLOs, private deployments (VPC/KMS), and cost controls (batching + cache). I can run the demo; Karthik will join for the technical deep-dive portion.

Please pick one of these 3 windows (all times PT):
1) Tue Nov 16 — 10:00–10:30am
2) Wed Nov 17 — 2:00–2:30pm
3) Thu Nov 18 — 9:30–10:00am

I've attached a 1-page discovery summary for your records (20261112-discovery-notes.pdf). If none of the above work, share 2–3 times that fit Priya and Rahul and we'll accommodate.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198

Attachment: 20261112-discovery-notes.pdf (summary of call)
